##### Project general facts

Nad Al Sheba Gardens is a private gated residential community surrounded by winding pathways and beautifully landscaped lawns, offering a peaceful and exclusive setting for modern family living. The development features a selection of luxurious 4-, 5-, and 6-bedroom villas, as well as spacious three-storey townhouses, all thoughtfully designed to combine contemporary architecture with generous living spaces. Double-height ceilings and abundant natural light further enhance the sense of space and elegance throughout the homes.

The community is designed around a serene and green environment, with carefully landscaped surroundings creating a pleasant setting for residents to relax and enjoy outdoor living. Winding pathways and manicured lawns provide a peaceful atmosphere while encouraging a strong connection with nature. The gated environment offers privacy and security, creating a comfortable setting where families can enjoy a relaxed lifestyle.

The residences feature contemporary architecture and high-quality finishes, with each collection offering its own distinctive design. The 5- and 6-bedroom villas feature light-beige façades, smoke-grey roofs, spacious balconies, open-plan interiors, and double-height living areas, while the 4-bedroom villas combine cubic forms with honeycomb tones and brushed bronze accents. The townhouses feature clean lines, pitched roofs, double-height ceilings, and spacious balconies connected to landscaped gardens. All homes include equipped kitchens and are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is one of Dubai’s most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan’s master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations.

The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area’s elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan.

Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai’s most forward-looking districts.
